collection.description: A craftsperson imagines workshops where enormous mechanisms make hundreds of identical baskets, garments, or tools.

setup.name: The setup
setup.text: A craftsperson imagines workshops where enormous mechanisms make hundreds of identical baskets, garments, or tools.

a1.name: Outcome A1
a1.text: The village imagines useful objects becoming affordable to more families.

a2.name: Outcome A2
a2.text: An artisan fears that uniform goods might displace locally meaningful work.

b1.name: Outcome B1
b1.text: A child asks who gathers materials and tends the mechanisms.

b2.name: Outcome B2
b2.text: A builder imagines dangerous conditions hidden behind plentiful products.

c1.name: Outcome C1
c1.text: The villagers wonder where broken objects and leftover materials go.

c2.name: Outcome C2
c2.text: A researcher suggests that efficiency means little if forests and waters bear the cost.
